# 1975–76 Kansas City Kings season

The 1975–76 NBA season was the Kings 27th season in the NBA and their fourth season in the city of Kansas City. Although the team dropped "Omaha" from the team name, the Kings would play six games in Omaha and play games on occasion there until 1978.
